```{r}
#| label: setup

library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(glue)
library(gt)

# Parent doc reads the artifacts produced by pst_fw_angler_trips_assembly.R.
# It renders with partial outputs by design: anything missing is reported
# as a gap rather than raising an error (design rule R2).

# Paths mirror the assembly script exactly (OUT_DIR / PST_DIR), now pointed
# at the numbered-by-pipeline-step outputs subfolders. This file renders from
# analysis/pst/; here::here() resolves from the repo root either way. Child
# {{< include >}} paths, by contrast, are relative to this file.
OUT_DIR <- here::here("analysis", "pst", "outputs", "05_assembly")
INTERVIEW_PROPS_DIR <- here::here("analysis", "pst", "outputs", "04_interview_proportions")
PST_DIR <- here::here("input_files", "pst", "lookup_tables")

read_if <- function(path, ...) {
  if (file.exists(path)) readr::read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE, ...) else NULL
}

manifest    <- read_if(file.path(PST_DIR, "pst_input_manifest.csv"))
crosswalk   <- read_if(file.path(PST_DIR, "pst_river_block_crosswalk.csv"))
effort      <- read_if(file.path(OUT_DIR, "pst_fw_trips_by_mode_location.csv"))
effort_area <- read_if(file.path(OUT_DIR, "pst_fw_trips_by_crc_area.csv"))
provenance  <- read_if(file.path(OUT_DIR, "pst_fw_provenance_ledger.csv"))
gaps        <- read_if(file.path(OUT_DIR, "pst_fw_gap_register.csv"))
coverage    <- read_if(file.path(OUT_DIR, "pst_fw_crc_coverage.csv"))
crc_bias    <- read_if(file.path(OUT_DIR, "pst_fw_crc_vs_creel_bias.csv"))
```

::: {.callout-note}
## What this document is

This is the **parent** for the PST freshwater angler trips work. It is
assembled from child documents via `{{< include >}}`, each owning one part of
the framework, assembly, or status:

- `01_intro_methods/` — purpose and deliverable contract, the two-track
  framework, and the pipeline registry.
- `03_analysis/` — Track A tiering as executed, Track B proportion results,
  and current assembly status and gaps.

Every child inherits this document's knitr session: the objects loaded in
`setup` above (`effort`, `effort_area`, `provenance`, `gaps`, `coverage`,
`crc_bias`, `manifest`, `crosswalk`) and the `read_if()` helper are available
to every included file without being redefined. Per design rule R2, this doc
is expected to render cleanly from an **empty** pipeline — every child chunk
that touches an artifact checks for its presence first and reports a gap
rather than erroring. Rendering with partial or absent outputs is the normal
state, not a failure mode.
:::

# Glossary & unit conventions

**Angler trips vs. angler days.** Not interchangeable. The consultant's
template says "angler days"; what the creel infrastructure produces is angler
trips. A multi-day angler generates multiple trips; a single trip does not
necessarily span a day. This distinction is surfaced explicitly to Jim and to
Northern Economics rather than absorbed silently in the pipeline.

**Trip calculation.**
$$
\text{total\_trips\_est} = \frac{\text{total\_effort\_hrs}}{\text{mean\_trip\_length}}
$$
Group size is applied upstream, when effort is expanded — not in this
division. Angler-hours vs. boat-hours vs. party-hours must be confirmed with
each data provider before any trip figure is computed from their file. This
has been the single most common source of silent error in inherited
spreadsheets.

**License year.** CRC harvest files are reported on a license year running
April 1 – March 31. This is *not* a fiscal year and the two should not be
used interchangeably in correspondence. Conversion to calendar year is a
documented step in the assembly script, not an assumption.

**Block.** The geographic/management unit within which a ratio is assumed
portable. Defined by `input_files/pst/lookup_tables/pst_river_block_crosswalk.csv`, following CRC's own `region` field. The delivered blocks are PugetSound, WACoast, and four Columbia-tributary blocks split by CRC region - ColumbiaLower, ColumbiaMiddle, ColumbiaUpper, ColumbiaSnake (a single "ColumbiaTrib" until 2026-08-19, split because it masked that Hanford Reach/McNary sit in a different CRC region than Cowlitz/Lewis). ColumbiaMainstem (the actual Buoy 10/LCR/Bonneville-McNary reaches) is documented in the crosswalk but not delivered - filtered out at load.
